organisms.name: Glowleaf Beetle
organisms.description: A small forest crawler that lights up mossy paths and helps break down fallen leaves.
organisms.habitat: Mossy forest floors, damp clearings, and shaded wetlands
organisms.environment_role: Pollinator and decomposer contributing to forest health
organisms.notes: Often found near decaying logs in low light areas.

organisms.name: Streamfin Dart
organisms.description: A fast-moving water creature that darts through stream pools and helps keep currents clean.
organisms.habitat: Freshwater streams, ponds, and slow rivers
organisms.environment_role: Water cleaner and algae balancer for healthy waterways
organisms.notes: Best spotted near submerged plants and gentle currents.

organisms.name: Sunflare Sprout
organisms.description: A bright, cheerful plant that opens in sunlight and provides food and shelter to small wildlife.
organisms.habitat: Sunny meadows, hillsides, and garden edges
organisms.environment_role: Food source and nesting cover for insects and small animals
organisms.notes: The most eye-catching cards show it glowing in golden hour light.
